Think twice before handing your iPhone to a stranger.

If someone asks to make an urgent phone call, they could leave the Phone app and start browsing your photos, messages, contacts, or other apps in seconds.

Before handing over your iPhone, turn on Guided Access.

Here’s how:

1. Go to Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access and turn it on.
2. Open the Phone app.
3. Triple-press the Side Button to lock your iPhone to that single app.
4. Triple-press again and enter your passcode to exit.

It’s one of the easiest iPhone privacy features that more people should know about.
